milestone.title: mp autopilot end-to-end certification — remediation, restart, topology, completion

intent.outcome: A production-shaped integration suite certifies that the complete autopilot stack drives queued work through remediation and terminal completion without raul.

problem.description: The component milestones can pass independently while their command, event, actor, and lifecycle contracts still disagree. A final certification milestone must integrate them without becoming the place where missing component behavior is first implemented.

in_scope: Three-pane full milestone with one remediation cycle and independent review pass.
Restart during runner and reviewer phases without duplicate dispatch.
Two-pane restricted policy and one-pane full-milestone rejection.
Multi-milestone queue ordering, terminal summary, and raul-absent operation.
out_of_scope: New component behavior not already owned by prerequisite milestones.
Legacy watch removal and raul presentation details.

acceptance_criteria.description: A three-pane fixture drives two queued milestones through step/AC evidence, independent review, one remediation cycle, finding fixed_in resolution, reviews pass, and lifecycle complete without raul.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p mp --test watch_execution -E 'test(/m226_ac01/)' --no-fail-fast exit 0 (5/5 pass)

acceptance_criteria.description: Restart injection during runner and reviewer phases preserves queue order and produces no duplicate dispatch, finding, or lifecycle transition.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p mp --test watch_execution -E 'test(/m226_ac02/)' --no-fail-fast exit 0 (4/4 pass)

acceptance_criteria.description: Topology certification proves two-pane no-ship-with-backlog behavior and rejects one-pane full milestones before plan mutation.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p mp --test watch_execution -E 'test(/m226_ac03/)' --no-fail-fast exit 0 (4/4 pass)

design_decisions.choice: The certification milestone may add fixtures and adapters only; any missing production behavior is routed back to its owning prerequisite milestone.
design_decisions.rationale: Keeping integration certification free of feature implementation prevents ownership drift and oversized remediation.

work_packages.name: Full-stack certification
work_packages.goal: Exercise only prerequisite-owned behavior in production-shaped queued drives.
work_packages.rollback: Keep component milestones shippable but do not advertise unattended autopilot as certified.

steps.action: Build a three-pane two-milestone integration fixture covering evidence, independent review, remediation, fixed_in, reviews pass, and complete.
steps.done_when: AC-01 completes both milestones without raul.

steps.action: Inject orchestrator restart in runner and reviewer phases and assert queue/idempotency invariants.
steps.done_when: AC-02 produces no duplicate durable effects.

steps.action: Add two-pane restriction and one-pane full-milestone rejection certification cases.

findings.description: AC-02 runner restart dedup test (m226_ac02_runner_restart_dedup_via_fake_herdr at crates/mp/tests/watch_execution.rs:2244) calls dispatch_assignment() directly to certify the 'no duplicate dispatch' contract. dispatch_assignment has NO production caller — production spawn goes through cmd_watch_drive -> SystemDriveOps::ensure_pane / send_prompt_to -> RealHerdrSpawnOps::start_agent (crates/mp/src/autopilot/spawn.rs:418) and never consults was_already_applied. The M225 F-01 fix added was_already_applied INSIDE dispatch_assignment, but dispatch_assignment itself is dead code in production. The certification test passes because it exercises the library API surface, not the production hot path. The M225 reviewer's cycle-2 verdict accepted the wiring claim without verifying a production caller exists for dispatch_assignment. A 'runner restart with a stored AssignmentDispatched event' would NOT short-circuit in production — it would fall through to RealHerdrSpawnOps::start_agent. Fix path: wire dispatch_assignment (or an equivalent typed dispatch that calls was_already_applied) into SystemDriveOps::send_prompt_to so the production spawn path consults the session event log before spawning.

AC-01 remediation flow tests (4 tests: m226_ac01_cycle1_finding_blocks_complete_and_is_remediable, m226_ac01_cycle2_fixed_in_resolution_reaches_complete, m226_ac01_second_milestone_completes_clean, m226_ac01_two_milestone_queue_both_complete_independently) and AC-03 completion test (m226_ac03_three_pane_drive_to_complete_preserves_evidence) all call LifecycleClosure::execute directly. LifecycleClosure has NO production caller — production milestone completion goes through complete_milestone (crates/mp/src/milestone/complete.rs:285) which mutates the milestone file via with_milestone_mut_unlocked and never invokes LifecycleClosure. Audit confirms LifecycleClosure::execute appears in src/ only inside crates/mp/src/autopilot/lifecycle.rs (its own unit tests); every other use is in crates/mp/tests/. The M226 AC-01 description claims 'A three-pane fixture drives two queued milestones through step/AC evidence, independent review, one remediation cycle, finding fixed_in resolution, reviews pass, and lifecycle complete without raul' — but the tested fixture exercises the in-process closure API, not the production milestone completion path. If the runner uses the production mp milestone complete command today, the closure ceremony (idempotency_key matching, journal replay on resume, refuse-out-of-order) is NOT enforced — it lives only in the untested library API. Fix path: wire LifecycleClosure::execute into complete_milestone (or replace complete_milestone with a driver that delegates to LifecycleClosure), THEN re-certify.

AC-03 topology tests (m226_ac03_two_pane_policy_is_no_ship_with_backlog, m226_ac03_one_pane_full_milestone_rejected_without_recorded_bypass, m226_ac03_three_pane_full_milestone_accepted_under_full_matrix) call topology_policy() and topology_preflight() / start_cycle() directly. These have NO production caller — cmd_watch_drive (crates/mp/src/commands/watch.rs:231) does not consult the topology preflight; start_cycle is only called from cycle.rs unit tests. A 1-pane full milestone would NOT be rejected at plan-mutation time in production — the M209 topology gate is dead code in the production hot path. The M226 AC-03 description claims 'Topology certification proves ... rejects one-pane full milestones before plan mutation' but the tested function is library-only and not on the production startup path. Audit: topology_preflight / start_cycle appear in crates/mp/src/ only inside crates/mp/src/autopilot/role.rs and crates/mp/src/autopilot/cycle.rs; commands/watch.rs and commands/autopilot.rs do not import them. The 1-pane full-milestone rejection contract is unenforced in production. Fix path: call topology_preflight at the top of cmd_watch_drive (after preconditions and before startup_recovery) so a 1-pane full milestone returns the typed TopologyPreflightError before any plan mutation, THEN re-certify.
